description: A React component for rendering multiple deck.gl layers with dynamic viewport adjustment, layer filtering, and integration with Redux state, used within the Apache Superset project.

classes.name: DeckMultiProps
classes.description: TypeScript type defining props for the DeckMulti React component.

methods.name: getAdjustedViewport
methods.description: Calculates and returns the adjusted viewport based on data points and autozoom setting.

methods.name: setTooltip
methods.description: Sets the tooltip content in the deck.gl container.

methods.name: getLayerIndex
methods.description: Determines the index of a layer within the deck slices.

methods.name: processLayerFilters
methods.description: Processes and combines filters for a specific layer based on form data and layer scope.

methods.name: createLayerFromData
methods.description: Creates a deck.gl layer instance from slice data and payload JSON.

methods.name: loadSingleLayer
methods.description: Loads a single layer by fetching data from URL and updating state.

methods.name: loadLayers
methods.description: Loads all layers based on form data, payload, and visibility filters.
